race.title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Nursery
race.verdict: ANGELIC MELODY is drawn on the wing but shaped quite well when fourth on nursery debut at Southwell and can improve further here to get off the mark. North Coates improved when second at Musselburgh last time and is respected with the step back up to 6f likely to suit, whilst Ma Fille de Reve remains of interest on her Thirsk second. ANGELIC MELODY (IRE) NORTH COATES MA FILLE DE REVE
